title: Stage 7: Saving and the Finale
lessonSummary: Done! Your game saves, loads and runs in a game loop.

tasks.instruction: Run this example: saving, loading and the finale.

The world, the player class and the player `player` (with Torch in the inventory) are given. Build the dictionary `data` with `name`, `position`, `hp` and `inventory` (list of names) and print `json.dumps(data)` (`import json`).

Write `load(filename)` that reads the file with `json.load`. If the file is missing, catch the `FileNotFoundError`, print exactly 📂 There is no saved game yet. and return `None`. Call `load("missing.json")`.
